practiceCheckin.narrative:
This demonstrates how Asinu presents a result after collecting the relevant information. In a real check-in, this area explains the reported symptoms, considers the relevant context and acknowledges uncertainty.

This guide only moves through sample screens. Example selections and anything typed during the guide are not used to assess your health.

- Read the explanation to understand a real check-in result.
- Review suggested next steps and signs that call for help.
- Replay the narration or open Expert consultation when needed.
practiceCheckin.disclaimer: This is a screen example, not a health assessment of the person viewing it.
practiceCheckin.close: Tap Finish the guide to return home. This example does not schedule a follow-up.

You can try Replay, see the Expert consultation button and explore the example situations. The guide does not assess your health, alert your family or schedule reminders. Tap Finish the guide to return home.
